package.description: Calculate Hashes to verify the integrity of your files

en-US.description: Calculate Hashes to verify the integrity of your files
en-US.longDescription: A freeware utility to calculate the hash of multiple files. This is a 128-bit number usually expressed as a 32 character hexadecimal number. It can be said to be the 'signature' of a file or string and is used in many applications, including checking the integrity of downloaded files. This compact application helps you quickly and easily list the hashes of your files.
en-US.name: Hash Tool

zh-CN.description: 计算哈希值，确保您的文件完整性
zh-CN.longDescription: 一款用于计算多个文件哈希值的免费工具。该工具生成的哈希值通常是一个 128 位数字，以 32 位十六进制数形式呈现。可将其视为文件或字符串的“数字签名” ，广泛应用于各类场景，包括校验下载文件的完整性。这款轻量级应用程序能帮助您快速便捷地获取文件哈希值列表。
